messages.content: Expand one assigned macro beat job into one concise visible video beat. Preserve every materially required action/result in the assigned job and their order. Do not drop a later clause merely to simplify the beat. Return only the beat sentence.

ASSIGNED JOB: A zombie breaks the kitchen door window. Amy rushes Will and Amber to the basement and locks the door.

Write one concise beat sentence for an 8-second clip. The beat must visibly accomplish the entire assigned job. Do not perform the next job (retrieving weapons).
